headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Deccan Chronicle / India Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: No Interest in Fighting with Centre, Says Revanth.
J&K Police attaches land belonging to 5 Pakistan-based terror handlers in Reasi.
Stadiums In Telangana Get Spruced Up For Khelo India Games.
De-Novo draft electoral rolls published for MLC constituencies.
No Let-Up in Recoveries From Defaulting Rice Millers: Uttam.
bullets_ur: Centre ke sath larnay ka koi irada nahi, Revanth Reddy ka bayan.
J&K Police ne Reasi mein Pakistan mein maqam rakhay 5 terror handlers ki zameen qurab kar li.
Khelo India Games ke liye Telangana ke stadiums ko behtar banaya ja raha hai.
MLC constituencies ke liye de-novo draft voter lists shaya kar di gayi hain.
Defaulting rice millers se wasooli mein koi kami nahi aayi: Uttam.
